metadata.title: PLTR support and resistance levels to watch

content.text:
Investing.com -- Palantir Technologies Inc (PLTR) is trading at $161.69, up 4.32%, as of Nov 6, 10:26 AM EST. The rebound is notable, but the daily trend remains weak.
Nearby Battlegrounds
-
First support: $158.12 — the daily pivot, just below current price.
-
Major support: $149.53–$153.54 — daily S1 near $149.53 and the 200-day SMA near $153.54.
-
Deeper support: $144.06 — daily S2, relevant if selling pressure returns.
-
First resistance: $163.59–$164.27 — daily R1 near $163.59 and the 100-day SMA near $164.27.
-
Major resistance: $172.18–$172.22 — daily R2 near $172.18 and the 100-day EMA near $172.22.
-
Overhead supply: $176–$183 — weekly resistance and the daily 10-day EMA area.
What Matters
Bearish structure: Daily moving averages remain heavily negative, while ADX at 27.7 suggests the downtrend has meaningful strength.
Bounce risk: Daily RSI at 32.7 and Stochastic readings in oversold territory leave room for a short-term rebound. Oversold, however, is a condition—not a reversal signal.
Volatility warning: Daily ATR is $9.60, classified as high volatility. PLTR can therefore move through nearby levels quickly.
A break below $158.12 would expose the $149.53–$153.54 support band. A sustained move above $164.27 would improve the near-term tone, with $172.18–$172.22 as the next meaningful test.
A break below the $158.12 support on Palantir Technologies Inc (PLTR) would weaken the rebound case.
A break above the $164.27 resistance on Palantir Technologies Inc (PLTR) would signal improving near-term momentum.
